answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved great success in the last few years. The popular Transformer model, which outperforms previous RNN/CNN based translation models, is based on multi-layer self-attention networks and can be parallelized effectively.

answer_2.quote: We followed all the other settings of . We averaged the last 5 checkpoints saved with an interval of 1,500 training steps. For decoding, we used a beam size of 4, and evaluated tokenized case-sensitive BLEU.
